references.text: David asks for God's watch over his mouth and to be kept from the wicked, which reflects Jesus' desire that the disciples should keep watch with him.
Mark gives a parallel account where Jesus finds Peter, James, and John sleeping and urges them to stay awake and pray so they will not fall into temptation.
Luke describes a similar event where Jesus finds the disciples asleep from sorrow and urges them to stay awake and pray.
